36133dfd4d9525ce16b9f8e5b733cc65.overview: A rich man's chauffeur kills his mistress and frames his daughter's fiancé.

36159a27701c27bb7dd893d92006c035.overview: In 1999, a woman's life is forever changed after she survives a car crash with two bank robbers, who enlist her help to take the money to a drop in Paris. On the way, she runs into another fugitive from the law — an American doctor on the run from the CIA. They want to confiscate his father's invention – a device which allows anyone to record their dreams and visions.

365a27dd19d4173412ba5a6b4d5685f3.overview: Advertising man Roger Thornhill is mistaken for a spy, triggering a deadly cross-country chase.
365a27dd19d4173412ba5a6b4d5685f3.tagline: It's a deadly game of "tag" and Cary Grant is "it"!

36859a7623de8b6ba6668f0103d5d465.overview: Alice, the only relatively normal member of the eccentric Sycamore family, falls in love with Tony Kirby, but his wealthy banker father and snobbish mother strongly disapprove of the match. When the Kirbys are invited to dinner to become better acquainted with their future in-laws, things don't turn out the way Alice had hoped.
36859a7623de8b6ba6668f0103d5d465.tagline: You'll love them all for giving you the swellest time you've ever had!

36975d8b516bdeb901e7f3c89574a6b2.overview: A vain businessman puts strains on his happy marriage to a rich, beautiful socialite by allowing himself to be seduced by a former girlfriend.
36975d8b516bdeb901e7f3c89574a6b2.tagline: I was married to a man other women pursued!

369ccfc2e6b0ca8fb09bbafe6726416c.overview: In the fall of 1963, Eddie Birdlace is an 18-year-old Marine Corps volunteer who is about to ship out with three of his buddies for a tour of duty in Vietnam. Planning a massive blowout for their last night in San Francisco, Eddie, his buddies, and a number of other Marines set up a contest they call a "dogfight”.
369ccfc2e6b0ca8fb09bbafe6726416c.tagline: The rules of the dogfight were simple. Everyone puts in fifty bucks. The guy with the ugliest "date" wins.

36cbd97e272df9fd3f2c43ba6450bce6.overview: Three steelworkers enlist in the army and are sent to Vietnam, one leaving behind a rushed marriage, the others a shared love. What they encounter during the war changes their lives forever.
36cbd97e272df9fd3f2c43ba6450bce6.tagline: One of the most important and powerful films of all time!

36ec7836fa113d093b80c74e9f304df7.overview: In 1979 Santa Barbara, California, Dorothea Fields is a determined single mother in her mid-50s who is raising her adolescent son, Jamie, at a moment brimming with cultural change and rebellion. Dorothea enlists the help of two younger women – Abbie, a free-spirited punk artist living as a boarder in the Fields' home and Julie, a savvy and provocative teenage neighbour – to help with Jamie's upbringing.

36f007828f3151b21a94505ccc10660d.overview: A Parisian tailor goes to a château to collect a bill, only to fall for an aloof young princess living there.
36f007828f3151b21a94505ccc10660d.tagline: Warm Love! Hilarious fun! Sweet music! Hot lyrics!

36fa8488cec17cc1b25e4d7c2e4c15aa.overview: Madcap couple George and Marion Kerby are killed in an automobile accident. They return as ghosts to try and liven up the regimented lifestyle of their friend and bank president, Cosmo Topper. When Topper starts to live it up, it strains relations with his stuffy wife.
